title: Nang Gunsang Pe Galumbang
chord: Ab · G · Am · F · C · G · F · Ab
lyrics:
Binoto jonok ni adamhu?
Aringku lao bodari ro
Aik sura ro tompu ponjothu
Parpudi i binoto do?
Jesus, Jesus
Marhite mudarMi

Pasonang hamamatengki
Jotjot asing di potang ari
Asa di manogotna i
Ai tagan au dison mansari
Tongtong tagamon ajalhi
Jesus, Jesus

Marhite mudarMi
Pasonang hamamatengki
Ajari au ale Tuhanku
Mamingkir hamamatengki
Huhut paingot ma rohangku
Tongtong di hamamateMi

Jesus, Jesus
Marhite mudarMi
Pasonang hamamatengki
Urupi ahu paturehon
Langkangku na di tano on
Paingot ma au mangalehon

Tu Ho Tuhanku rohangkon
Jesus, Jesus
Marhite mudarMi
Pasonang hamamatengki
Baen lam tonggi di ahu Surgo
Lam paet huhut portibi on

Sai naeng tu ginjang au manggogo
Saleleng au di tano on
Jesus, Jesus
Marhite mudarMi
Pasonang hamamatengki
Huphupi ma sude dosangku

O Jesus dohot mudarMi
I do hubaen parulosonku
Manopot hasonangan i
Jesus, Jesus
Marhite mudarMi
Pasonang hamamatengki

Tu Ho o Jesus au palohot
Rohangku lonong di rohaM
Manang di dia Ho au dohot
Dison pe nang di banuaM
Jesus, Jesus
Marhite mudarMi

Pasonang hamamatengki
Antong nang ro pe hamatean
Marsogot nang sadari on
Ndang habiaran be udean
Ai Jesus do di au tongtong
Jesus, Jesus

Marhite mudarMi
Pasonang hamamatengki
Ipe na sonang au mangolu
Ndang marsak au lao mate pe
Huboto do sai dipangolu
Ho au di hamamatengki

Jesus, Jesus
Marhite mudarMi
Pasonang hamamatengki
